channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indian Rupee rises as RBI intervention suppresses impact of higher oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee gains strongly after a flat opening against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday. The USD/INR pair declines to near 96.50 as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has intervened again to support the Indian Rupee.

item.title: Russian Ruble: CBR seen holding rate despite pressure to cut – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose expects Russia’s central bank to keep its key rate at 14.25%, despite political and economic pressure for a cut. Surging inflation expectations, higher Oil and commodity prices, and accelerating Consumer Price Index (CPI) argue against easing.

item.title: British Pound steadies against Japanese Yen following outperformance in UK Retail Sales
item.description: GBP/JPY remains calm after six days of losses, trading around 218.20 during the early European hours on Friday. The currency cross holds its ground as the British Pound (GBP) receives support from the release of stronger-than-expected UK Retail Sales data.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Softens below 1.4100, but bullish outlook stays intact above key support
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades in negative territory near 1.4075 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Escalating conflicts in the Middle East boost crude oil prices, supporting the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: ECB's Kocher: Don't see evidence of second-round effects
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Martin Kocher said on Friday that he doesn’t see any hard evidence of second-round effects, but the central bank will act if the inflation outlook deteriorates.

item.title: Euro extends rally against British Pound despite strong UK Retail Sales data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) rallies further against the British Pound (GBP) as the latter weakens despite upbeat United Kingdom (UK) Retail Sales data for June. The EUR/GBP pair jumps to near 0.8550 in the European trading session on Friday, the highest level seen in two weeks.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Higher yields and FOMC focus lift DXY – MUFG
item.description: Lloyd Chan at MUFG notes that US rate expectations remain volatile, with markets now pricing further Federal Reserve (Fed) tightening this year. Rising Treasury yields have pushed the US Dollar (USD) higher, lifting the US Dollar Index (DXY).

item.title: Gold: Oil spike caps rebound and keeps risks two-way – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note Gold has retreated back toward USD 4,040/4,050 after briefly trading above 4,160 as Brent surged past USD100 and the Dollar and US yields climbed.

item.title: British Pound remains depressed near 1.3300 despite upbeat UK Retail Sales data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) remains pinned near three-week lows against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, trading near 1.3300 and on track for a 1% weekly decline.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah advances as US Dollar struggles despite increasing risk aversion
item.description: USD/IDR depreciates after registering over 0.5% gains in the previous day, trading around 18,020 during the Asian hours on Friday. However, the pair may see upward momentum following Bank Indonesia's (BI) unexpected decision to hold its benchmark interest rate steady at 5.75% in July.

item.title: Brent: Conflict risks keep prices supported – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Brent has broken above $100/bbl as Middle East tensions escalate and supply risks mount. They highlight threats to flows through the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, as well as disruptions to Kazakh exports.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Surging US bond yields warrant downside
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades marginally higher at around 0.6976 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday.

item.title: Euro: Weakens despite ECB rate hike signals against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB Global Economics & Markets Research reports that EUR/USD slipped 0.3% to 1.1377 as the Euro (EUR) weakened against the US Dollar (USD) despite the European Central Bank (ECB) leaving rates unchanged and President Lagarde acknowledging some calls for a hike.

item.title: United Kingdom Retail Sales climb 1.0% MoM in June vs. -0.3% expected
item.description: Retail Sales, a key measure of consumer spending, in the United Kingdom (UK) climbed 1.0% month-over-month (MoM) in June after rising by 1.2% in May, the latest data published by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Friday.

item.title: Gold sticks to intraday losses below $4,050 amid Fed hike bets, bullish USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) remains under some selling pressure for the second straight day on Friday and weakens further below the $4,050 level during the Asian session.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Falls to near $90.00, while bullish structure stays intact
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $90.05 during the early European trading hours on Friday. WTI tumbles as traders book some profits.

item.title: Asian stocks decline on Trump's tariffs, US-Iran tension; South Korea's KOSPI underperform
item.description: Asian stock markets fell across the board on Friday as intensifying US-Iran conflict and US President Donald Trump's new tariffs temper investors' appetite for riskier assets. Japan’s Nikkei N225 is down nearly 3% while South Korea's KOSPI declined over 4.5%, underperforming broader markets.

item.title: ECB’s Nagel: Central bank is in a good position to respond to surging energy prices
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council Member and President of the Deutsche Bundesbank, Joachim Nagel, said on Friday that the central bank is in a good position to respond to surging energy prices.

item.title: Euro gains traction above 1.1350 as markets price in upcoming ECB rate hike
item.description: The EUR/USD pair gathers strength to near 1.1385 during the early European trading hours on Friday, bolstered by the prospect of imminent European Central Bank (ECB) rate hikes.

item.title: Swiss Franc remains weaker as US Dollar receives support amid US-Iran tensions
item.description: USD/CHF continues its winning streak for the fifth successive day, trading around 0.8170 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) pares its daily losses amid rising safe-haven demand due to escalating conflicts in the Middle East.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar trades with positive bias but lacks follow-through amid bullish USD
item.description: The NZD/USD pair attracts some buyers during the Asian session on Friday and moves away from a one-and-a-half-week trough, around the 0.5760 region touched the previous day.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Holds gains above 114.00, bullish vibe remains intact above 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 114.25 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on a strong Australian employment report for June.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Eyes rising wedge top near 187.00
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the fourth consecutive day, trading around 186.50 during the Asian hours on Friday. The currency cross is maintaining a bullish near-term bias as price holds above both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds gains near 101.50 on revival of hawkish Fed bets
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) clings to the previous day’s gains in the Asian session on Friday, as surging oil prices due to intensified Middle East energy supply risks have revived Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike expectations.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds gains above $57.50 despite rising Fed rate hike odds
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) inches higher after registering over 4% losses in the previous day, trading around $57.60 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: British Pound rebounds above 1.3300 ahead of UK Retail Sales data
item.description: The GBP/USD pair recovers some lost ground to near 1.3325, snapping the five-day losing streak during the Asian trading hours on Friday. However, the potential upside might be limited amid heightened military tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: Canadian Dollar edges higher vs soft USD; bulls seem hesitant amid mixed cues
item.description: The USD/CAD pair attracts fresh sellers during the Asian session on Friday and currently trades around the 1.4070 zone, down 0.10% for the day amid a softer US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Euro rises as US Dollar weakens despite rising Middle East tensions
item.description: EUR/USD gains ground after posting modest losses in the previous day, trading around 1.1380 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama says ready to act appropriately on currency shifts whenever necessary
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama delivered a verbal intervention on Friday, saying that authorities prepared to take decisive steps on foreign exchange.
